title: Il Mare (bc30)
synopsis: 1999, a young woman leaves her quaint seaside house and returns to the city, leaving in the mailbox a card for the next owner, with instructions to forward any mail of hers to the new address. 1997, a jaded young architect moves into the same house and finds the letter. His reply, which he slips into the mailbox, finds its way to her, beginning a parallel-time love story separated by a span of two years. Following the box office success of Christmas in August and Shiri, Il Mare further cemented the growing influence of Korean cinema.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1999 年，銀珠搬離海邊小屋前，在信箱留下一張卡片給未來的屋主，請對方代為轉寄信件。1997 年，失意的年輕建築師星賢搬進這幢房子，意外發現了這封信。兩人透過 神奇的信箱開始書信往來，漸漸熟絡起來。當銀珠的男朋友從美國回來，並已背着她和其他人訂婚，傷心欲絕的她立刻寫信給星賢，拜託他改變兩人的命運，但星賢已在不知不覺間愛上銀珠。儘管時空相隔兩年，兩人素未謀面，仍不阻命運之神譜出的一段奇幻戀曲。在《八月照相館》及《生死諜變》引領韓流後，《觸不到的戀人》進一步奠定韓國電影的影響力。

cast: Lee Jung-jae, Jun Ji-hyun, Kim Mu-saeng, Jo Seung-yeon, Min Yun-jae
